The '''bombing of the Senate Hall''' was a terrorist attack that occurred in the [[Senate Hall]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]].

==Origins==
Having just [[Bombing of Pydyr|bombed]] [[Pydyr]], the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Kueller]] wanted to use detonators concealed within [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to blow up the [[Senate Hall]] during the opening session following an election, so as to begin his hostilities against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and to send it into a political crisis. The droids were manufactured and fitted with the explosives on [[Telti/Legends|Telti]], under the guidance of [[Brakiss]], and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggled]] into [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] by a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] called [[Jarril]].<ref name="TNR" />

==The bombing==
The senate session began and [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] welcomed in the new [[Senator/Legends|senators]], such as [[Meido]], who had been former [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] and had been allowed to stand for election following the introduction of [[New Republic amnesty bill|new legislation]]. The droids with detonators within them were placed mainly around senators loyal to the New Republic, rather than around the former Imperials, and detonated. The explosion rocked the chamber and shrapnel rained down everywhere, while pieces of the crystal ceiling began falling to the ground and tiles put in by [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] came loose and fell across the hall like hail. The explosion also caused shock waves that caused surrounding buildings, like the [[Crystal Jewel]], to shake.<ref name="TNR" />

==Aftermath==
The explosion devastated the interior of the Senate Hall, but caused no major structural damage to the exterior. It killed 25 senators, including [[M'yet Luure]]; a number of senate guards; and injured another 100 senators. Leia Organa Solo also received minor injuries and was temporarily made deaf.<ref name="TNR" />

A contingent of guards and medical personnel was soon sent out to help the injured. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] also rushed to the hall to check that Leia was unharmed. Leia was convinced that the former Imperials had something to do with the attack, although Han believed that it had something to do with Jaril, who at the time of the explosion had been trying to warn him about something. Han and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] decided to travel to the [[Smuggler's Run/Legends|Smuggler's Run]] to investigate this theory further. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] also came to the chamber following the attack and was able to feel through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] that it had not been one large explosion, but several smaller ones and that Brakiss was in some way connected to it.<ref name="TNR" />

The majority of the former Imperials were unharmed and gained proportionally greater power, causing the development of a powerful new faction in the senate under the de facto leadership of Meido. They obtained circumstantial evidence to implicate Han Solo with causing the explosion and attempted to use this to force a vote of no confidence and get Chief of State Solo out of office.<ref name="TNR" />
